attributes.board_name: New York State Board for Veterinary Medicine (NYSED Office of the Professions)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Formal programs offered by sponsors approved by the NYS Education Department (state/national veterinary associations and affiliates, recognized veterinary conferences, veterinary colleges); courses from sponsors in other jurisdictions count if the sponsor is NY-approved
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt for the triennial registration period in which first licensed; registration periods shorter than 3 years are prorated.
rules.alternatives: Full-time faculty of a registered/accredited veterinary education program are exempt; inactive status exempts while not practicing.
rules.audit_note: Keep CE records at least 6 years; the Department audits. Missing CE → possible one-year conditional registration.

topics.who: Use, misuse, documentation, safeguarding and prescribing of controlled substances

rules.notes: Licensed veterinary technicians: 24 hours per 3-year registration period, max 12 self-instructional. Plus a $45 mandatory CE fee per registration period (fee shown is the triennial registration fee).
rules.rule_quote: During each triennial registration period an applicant for registration shall complete a minimum of twenty-four hours of acceptable formal continuing education, a maximum of twelve hours of which may be self-instructional coursework acceptable to the department.
